research_question: Among patients undergoing surgical management of an ankle fracture, what is the effect of a removable ankle support compared with a non-removable ankle support (such as a cast) on activity limitation or functional activity at the end of treatment?
treatment_label: Removable ankle support after surgical fracture management
control_label: Non-removable ankle support (e.g. cast) after surgical fracture management
outcome_description: Activity limitation or ankle-related function measured at the end of the assigned treatment period using validated or study-reported continuous instruments, including the Olerud-Molander Ankle Score (OMAS), Mazur score, or comparable activity/function scales. Scores will be harmonized so that higher values indicate better activity/function and pooled across instruments as standardized mean differences.
positive_direction: A positive standardized mean difference means that removable ankle support results in better activity/function (less activity limitation) at the end of treatment than non-removable support.
search_queries: ankle fracture surgery removable support cast functional outcome trial
operatively treated ankle fracture removable brace non-removable cast comparison
surgical ankle fracture removable orthosis immobilization activity function controlled study
inclusion_criteria: Original empirical studies of people receiving surgical management for ankle fracture that compare a removable ankle support with a non-removable ankle support such as a cast.

Studies reporting an end-of-treatment quantitative measure of activity limitation, ankle function, or closely comparable functional status using OMAS, Mazur score, or another relevant measurement tool.
Any broadly relevant comparative study design, care setting, participant age group, publication status, or language, provided usable outcome data are available.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study; systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, opinion pieces, and theoretical papers are excluded.
No comparison between a removable ankle-support treatment condition and a non-removable ankle-support control condition after surgical fracture management.
No quantitative outcome data that can produce an effect size; means and standard deviations, t/F values, proportions, odds ratios, or equivalent convertible data are required.
Completely unrelated to surgically managed ankle fractures, ankle-support removability, or activity/function outcomes.
moderators_to_extract: Type of removable support and type of non-removable support
Duration of immobilization/support and definition of end of treatment
Participant characteristics, including age group and fracture severity/type
effect_size_note: Pool continuous end-of-treatment activity/function outcomes as standardized mean differences. Orient all instruments so higher values represent better function, then calculate SMDs with small-sample correction where appropriate. If multiple eligible activity/function instruments are reported for the same sample and time point, apply a prespecified hierarchy or combine correlated outcomes to avoid double-counting participants.
single_outcome_target: activity limitation at end of treatment
